title: It is not a 10 inch pan.
text: It is not a 10 inch pan.. I didn't like the fact that it was not 10 inches, but 9 or 9.5 inches. A 10 inch pan is obviously hard to find. I have one that I bought many years ago that is glass. I think it is a Pyrex, but they don't even have 10 inch glass pans anymore.

product_metadata.title: Fat Daddio's PIE-6 Anodized Aluminum Pie Pan, 6 x 1.5 Inch
features: Ideal for any recipe - Designed for sweet pies and savory pot pies. Great for no-bake and freezer pies.

Preferred by Professionals - These pans are measured rim to rim and are slightly deeper than traditional pie pans at 1 1/2 inch depth. A flat 1/2-inch rim allows for smooth handling while creating classic bakery or artisan-style crusts.

Fits Perfectly - Fits 6 & 8-quart pressure cookers and 3.4, 4, 5.3 & 10-quart air fryers. Measures 6" (15.2 cm) top diameter, 5" (12.7 cm) top interior diameter, 4" (10.2 cm) bottom diameter, 1.5" (3.8 cm) depth.

18-Gauge Anodized Aluminum - Easy release and clean up. Safe for citrus-based foods unlike traditional bakeware. Will never rust, peel or flake. No extra metals, chemical additives, dyes, PTFE’s or PFOA’s. Hand wash recommended.
Built Bakery Tough - Built to last through daily use in both the home kitchen and commercial establishments.
